window_note: £7 every time you enter a terminal drop-off zone: no free period, no waiting, and a 10-minute maximum stay
overstay: No free period: £7 for each entry. Heathrow introduced a 10-minute maximum stay alongside the £7 charge in January 2026, and APCOA, which runs the zones, says a Parking Charge is issued if you stay longer; non-payment brings an £80 Parking Charge, reduced to £40 within 14 days
free_alternative: Park & Ride car parks (former Long Stay)
alt_detail: Free drop-off, with a free shuttle bus to the terminal every 15 minutes; pick-ups are free for the first 29 minutes (2 hours in Zone A for Terminal 4)

window_note: £10 for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £1 a minute for up to 20 more minutes; 30-minute maximum stay, £30 maximum daily charge
alt_detail: 2 hours free, with a shuttle bus every 10 to 12 minutes that takes about 10 to 12 minutes to the terminals

window_note: Express Set Down: £10 for up to 15 minutes
overstay: £28 for over 15 minutes; 30-minute maximum stay
alt_detail: First 60 minutes free — pick-up or drop-off — with a free shuttle taking about 7 minutes

window_note: £9 for up to 12 minutes
overstay: £1 per minute beyond 12 minutes; 30-minute maximum stay
alt_detail: 2 hours free, bus to terminal

window_note: £8 for up to 5 minutes (£1.60 a minute)
overstay: £1 per minute beyond 5 minutes; maximum stay 10 minutes
alt_detail: No free drop-off; DLR is the practical alternative

window_note: £5.50 for up to 5 minutes
overstay: £6.50 for up to 10 minutes; £25 for up to 30 minutes
alt_detail: Free drop-off at JetParks 1 (M90 5AZ) — one-way shuttle to the terminals, about 6 minutes, running 24/7 with marshals on hand

window_note: Premium Set Down outside the terminal: £8 for up to 15 minutes; the separate Drop Off car park is free for 10 minutes
overstay: £13 for 15–20 minutes, £19 for 20–25, £25 for 25–30, £31 for 30–35, £37 for 35–40, £43 for 40–45, £49 for 45–50, £55 for 50–55 and £61 for 55–60 minutes, then £8 for each extra 15 minutes
alt_detail: 10 minutes free, 400 metres from the terminal by covered walkway

window_note: £8.50 for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £1 per minute beyond 10 minutes
alt_detail: 30 minutes free in the Long Stay car park — no shuttle bus, a 10-minute walk to the terminal

window_note: £8.50 for up to 10 minutes at the Drop Off & Pick Up car park on the Transport Interchange, a few minutes' walk from the terminal
overstay: £10.50 for 10–20 minutes; £13 for 20–40 minutes; £30 for 40–60 minutes; £60 for 1–2 hours, the maximum stay
alt_detail: 60 minutes free, with a frequent bus to the Transport Interchange; temporarily relocated from 19 October to 18 December 2026, with no return within 30 minutes

window_note: £7 for up to 15 minutes
overstay: £1 per additional minute; £50 beyond 30 minutes
alt_detail: 1 hour free, walk or shuttle to terminal

window_note: £7 for up to 15 minutes
overstay: £1 per minute beyond 15 minutes; £50 flat charge after 30 minutes
alt_detail: 1 hour free, shuttle to terminal

window_note: £8 for up to 10 minutes in the Pick Up & Drop Off car park, a 1-minute walk from the terminal
overstay: £10 for 10–20 minutes, £13.50 for 20–30 minutes, £16.50 for 30–60 minutes, then £16.50 for each extra hour or part of one
alt_detail: Up to 1 hour free, a 3–4-minute uphill walk to the terminal via the Mid Stay walkway — £68 minimum charge if you re-enter within an hour

window_note: £6 for up to 10 minutes in the Express Car Park at the terminal
overstay: £12 for up to 30 minutes
alt_detail: 90 minutes free, with a free shuttle bus to the terminal

window_note: £7 for up to 10 minutes at the Express Drop-off and Pick-up area next to the terminal (gate rate)
overstay: £10 up to 20 minutes; £25 up to 1 hour; £50 up to 24 hours, then £50 for each further 24 hours
alt_detail: 20 minutes free at Drop-off 2, about a 7-minute walk from the terminal (no more than 10 minutes); leave and come back within two hours and it's a minimum £9

window_note: Rapid Drop Off: £8 for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £1 per minute beyond 10 minutes; 30-minute maximum stay
alt_detail: 60 minutes free; a 15–20 minute walk, or the free shuttle bus, which the airport suspended from November 2025 to March 2026, so check whether it runs this winter

window_note: £5 for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £8 for 10–20 minutes; £13 for 20–60 minutes; £60 over an hour
alt_detail: 15 minutes free for dropping off and collecting, behind the Maldron Hotel

window_note: £4 for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £6 for 10–20 minutes
alt_detail: 10 minutes free (take a ticket), then £7 up to an hour — a short walk to the terminal

window_note: £4.50 for up to 10 minutes (revised 1 July 2026)
overstay: £4.50 for each additional 10 minutes
alt_detail: 20 minutes free, about a 5-minute walk (booking sites also mention a free shuttle bus)

window_note: £8 for up to 30 minutes — longest paid window
overstay: £15 for 30–60 minutes
alt_detail: No free option prominently published

window_note: £7 for up to 20 minutes in the Pick Up & Drop Off area, ground floor of the short-stay multi-storey, 1-minute walk from terminal
overstay: Escalating charges
alt_detail: No free drop-off currently offered

window_note: £4.50 for up to 60 minutes in Car Park 1, directly outside the terminal (Sat Nav: KA9 2PL) — the most generous paid window in the UK
overstay: Standard parking rates apply beyond 60 minutes
alt_detail: Long window makes an alternative largely unnecessary

window_note: £8 for up to 10 minutes in the Express Pick-up and Drop-off area
overstay: Maximum stay 10 minutes — overstays bring a Parking Charge Notice
alt_detail: Southend withdrew its free drop-off option — the £8 Express area is the only set-down

window_note: FREE for up to 10 minutes
overstay: £3 up to 30 minutes and £5 up to 60 minutes in the West Car Park after the free 10 minutes
alt_detail: The drop-off itself is free — 10 minutes inside the barriered West Car Park

window_note: £8 for up to 15 minutes in Car Park P1, the drop-off and pick-up car park directly opposite the Main Terminal
overstay: £15 for 15–60 minutes; £20 for 1–4 hours
alt_detail: Free for up to 30 minutes for drop-off and pick-up

window_note: £8 for up to 20 minutes in the designated drop-off lane inside Car Park 1 (Short Stay), directly in front of the terminal
overstay: £15 for 20–60 minutes; £20 for 1–4 hours
alt_detail: No free drop-off published; stopping on approach roads and roundabouts is prohibited

window_note: £2.50 for up to 10 minutes in the main car park directly opposite the terminal
overstay: £5 for 10–60 minutes; £7 per hour thereafter
alt_detail: Up to 2 hours free in the same car park with a minimum £5 spend in the landside café or shops — show your receipt for validation

window_note: £3.90 for up to 30 minutes in the Premium, Accessible & Drop Off car park directly in front of the terminal
overstay: £10.80 for 30–60 minutes; £13.70 for 1–3 hours
alt_detail: 15 minutes free in the Short Stay & Free Drop-off car park (follow the green signs), then £3.90 to 30 minutes — no return within one hour

window_note: FREE for up to 15 minutes at the drop-off zone in Short Stay Car Park 1, adjacent to the terminal
overstay: £5 up to 1 hour; £9 for 1–2 hours; £15 for 2–5 hours; £20 for 5–8 hours; £25 for 8–11 hours; £30 up to 24 hours, then £30 for each additional day (turn-up prices from 1 June 2025, including VAT)
alt_detail: The drop-off zone itself is free for 15 minutes; Short Stay Car Park 1 is also free for up to 15 minutes if you're meeting an arriving flight

window_note: £1 for up to 20 minutes in the single car park directly outside the terminal — the lowest drop-off charge of any UK airport we track
overstay: £2.50 for 20 minutes–1 hour; £3.50 for 1–2 hours
alt_detail: No free general drop-off; Blue Badge vehicles dropping off or picking up get the first 2 hours free in designated bays
